how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-ashenvale-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:6545:title: ⟦E1⟧
rows.quest:6545:progress:0: So you're here with my orders? Always good to see a new recruit with an exuberant nature and a strong will.⟦1⟧⟦2⟧You'd best learn fast if you expect to keep up here. I have also discovered that the naga have taken over a large area of the land of ⟦E7⟧.⟦9⟧⟦10⟧It's good to see that we are still bolstering our numbers -- be ready for what lies ahead, ⟦11⟧.
rows.quest:6547:title: ⟦E8⟧
rows.quest:6547:progress:0: Keep an eye out, ⟦13⟧. The elves are often hiding in the shadows...⟦14⟧⟦15⟧We must always be watching. We have worked very hard to claim this land, and the elves are looking for a chance to take it from us.⟦16⟧⟦17⟧I assume you have my next orders from ⟦E3⟧?

rows.quest:1056:details:0: The forest spirits tell me you are brave and willing to travel.
rows.quest:1056:details:1: To the south, not far from Mystral Lake, there lies a tunnel named The Talondeep Path. Through this tunnel you will come to an area known as Windshear Crag in the ⟦E12⟧. Once there, journey to the southwest past Cragpool Lake and then north, up the steep slope until you reach Stonetalon Peak.
rows.quest:1056:completion:0: Alas, you arrive. I see Faldreas has listened to the forest spirits...
rows.quest:990:details:0: ⟦19⟧, my mistress, ⟦E13⟧, awaits you in the city of Astranaar within ⟦E6⟧. With your help, perhaps we can at least ease some of the corruption that's taken hold there.
rows.quest:990:details:1: Head south from here and stay close to the road--you'll find your way there without issue if you follow those directions.
rows.quest:990:completion:0: Ah, a ⟦20⟧ from ⟦E15⟧. Selarin has done well to send you here so quickly, ⟦21⟧. I wish your trip here wasn't under such dire stress. Perhaps with your help we can improve matters.
rows.quest:990:completion:1: I would start my visit by speaking to the other citizens of Astranaar. Some could surely use your aid.
rows.quest:991:details:0: ⟦22⟧, a longtime friend of mine is also aiding the Sentinels here in ⟦E6⟧, but he has yet to return.
rows.quest:991:details:1: He had leads on finding an item that he thought could slow the furbolg attacks on our people--a rod created by a now-dead, evil wizard.
rows.quest:991:details:2: Before he left here, he mentioned seeking out a gem for the rod.
rows.quest:991:details:3: He mentioned the gem possibly being hidden at the shrine in Lake Falathim at the base of the mountain to the west. The gem was being held there before it was overrun.
rows.quest:991:completion:0: Teronis' body lies broken atop the island. For some unknown reason, the murlocs have left it alone.
rows.quest:991:completion:1: The deep slashes across his corpse obviously came from the weapons and claws of the murlocs.
rows.quest:1008:obj:0: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to ⟦E16⟧ in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1008:details:0: There is evil lurking on our northwestern coast, known as the Zoram Strand.
rows.quest:1008:details:1: It is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, destroyed during the Sundering and submerged beneath the seas. It has been lost to the night elves for ages. Lost, and nearly forgotten.
rows.quest:1008:details:2: Now, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know. But reason matters little; we must slay these fiends and throw them back to the depths!
rows.quest:1008:details:3: Return to me when your mission is complete.
rows.quest:1008:progress:0: We cannot allow the naga to invade our coasts, ⟦24⟧.  It is vital that you go to the Zoram Strand and complete your mission.
rows.quest:1008:completion:0: Very well done, ⟦25⟧. Your actions in the Zoram Strand against the naga are commendable.
rows.quest:1008:completion:1: I know your feat was not easily accomplished, for the strength and guile of the naga is well known to the night elves. We know this, for we share a history with them.
rows.quest:1008:completion:2: It is a history I care not to repeat.
rows.quest:6442:obj:0: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to ⟦E17⟧ along the Zoram Strand.
rows.quest:6442:details:0: There is evil lurking here along the coast, ⟦26⟧.
rows.quest:6442:details:1: It is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, long destroyed and submerged beneath the seas. Lost, and nearly forgotten.
rows.quest:6442:details:2: Now, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know. But reason matters little; we must defend the land we have worked so hard to claim as our own.
rows.quest:6442:details:3: Return to me with 20 of their heads! Throw the naga back to the depths!
rows.quest:6442:progress:0: The naga increase in numbers, ⟦27⟧. Please complete this task for me.
rows.quest:6442:completion:0: We could use more of your kind around here, ⟦28⟧. Thank you for your help.
rows.quest:1007:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E18⟧ to ⟦E19⟧, in his camp near the Zoram Strand.
rows.quest:1007:details:0: I would charge you with a task, ⟦29⟧.
rows.quest:1007:details:1: I was on my small vessel, skimming over the submerged ruins of Zoram, when naga attacked me, surging from the water and tearing at me with their claws! I fled, carrying what supplies I could to make this meager camp.
rows.quest:1007:details:2: But when I reached the shore and ran... my prized possession was lost.
rows.quest:1007:details:3: Please, ⟦30⟧, find the site of my ambush, along the coast to the north, and search for an ancient statuette. It is the reason I have braved the dangers of the Zoram Strand.
rows.quest:1007:completion:1: The old city of Zoram holds many secrets, and this statuette may be the key to many of them.
rows.quest:1010:details:0: There is a plant that once grew in the old ruins of Bathran's Haunt to the north. The plant was called ⟦E20⟧ and was known to cure ailments of the spirit.
rows.quest:1010:details:1: There is a sick child in the village, and I believe it is more than just a physical illness. Will you go to Bathran's Haunt and search it for ⟦E20⟧? I may need it to properly treat the child.
rows.quest:1010:details:2: Bathran's Haunt lies north of Maestra's Post and just south of the border to ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:1010:progress:0: Have you gathered the ⟦E20⟧, ⟦33⟧?  The child's health grows weaker by the hour...
rows.quest:1010:completion:0: Ah, you have the hair! Now I will mix a cure for the child, and pray my concoction works.
rows.quest:1010:completion:1: And... ⟦E22⟧ are at Bathran's Haunt? Very troubling to hear, that is. Very troubling indeed...
rows.quest:1020:details:0: ⟦34⟧, I have created a cure that I believe will help the afflicted child. Take it to Astranaar and give it to the child's parent, ⟦E24⟧.
rows.quest:1020:details:1: To reach Astranaar, follow the road south, then east.
rows.quest:1020:progress:0: I must apologize, for I have no time to speak.  My child, Relara, is deathly ill!
rows.quest:1020:completion:1: His skill with herbs and healing is great. This cure gives me hope, when before I had little...
rows.quest:6383:completion:0: There are three legendary creatures that make up the ⟦E6⟧ Hunt; you may seek them and test yourself against their cunning and might. In the process, you will hopefully learn something about yourself. The creatures are: the bear Ursangous, the nightsaber cat Shadumbra, and the hippogryph Sharptalon.
rows.quest:6383:completion:1: The creatures of the ⟦E6⟧ Hunt are powerful, and you may find that you'll need aid in bringing them down. If you should best them, bring me proof of your deed.
rows.quest:908:title: ⟦E26⟧ -- Might not exist //Braghe
rows.quest:908:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E27⟧ to ⟦E28⟧ at Zoram'gar Outpost, ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:908:details:0: The Twilight's ⟦E29⟧ has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of ⟦E30⟧.  Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us.  If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good.⟦35⟧⟦36⟧⟦37⟧, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water. Whatever the Twilight's ⟦E29⟧ is up to in there - and believe me when I say it is no good - my comrades and I will now uncover.⟦38⟧⟦39⟧You've done well here today; the ⟦E31⟧ looks upon you warmly for assisting us. You've also helped the ⟦E32⟧ as a whole, and for that you should be proud.
rows.quest:1023:obj:0: Find the ⟦E33⟧ and return to ⟦E13⟧ in Astranaar with ⟦E34⟧.
rows.quest:1023:details:0: As you rummage through Teronis' belongings, you find a journal that is still in good condition.
rows.quest:1023:details:1: You take the journal and leave Teronis' corpse as is.
rows.quest:1023:details:2: The only thing left to do is find the gem Teronis was seeking. Raene mentioned it being in the area. Perhaps the murlocs have it...
rows.quest:1023:completion:0: This is terrible, ⟦41⟧. Teronis is dead?!
rows.quest:1023:completion:1: The time for mourning will come, but for now we must focus our efforts. I shall send some of the Sentinels to recover Teronis' body as soon as possible.
rows.quest:1023:completion:2: You have Teronis' journal and the gem he was seeking. Do you think you're capable of completing his task? I would rest much better knowing his death was not in vain.
rows.quest:1024:obj:0: Find ⟦E35⟧ at the moonwell to the northeast.
rows.quest:1024:details:0: You'll have to do the research yourself, but from what notes Teronis has made, it sounds like your next course of action is to find the other pieces of the rod Dartol created. I would start by heading to the moonwell east of Iris Lake. When you're ready, follow the road and turn north when you reach a small sitting area on your left.
rows.quest:1024:details:1: BA dryad there named ⟦E35⟧ is better suited to guide you. Seek her out.
rows.quest:1024:details:2: Keep the gem with you--⟦E35⟧ will need it if she's to help you recreate the rod.
rows.quest:1024:completion:0: Oh, Raene sent you? It must be serious indeed. What can I help you with?
rows.quest:1070:obj:0: Find ⟦E36⟧ overlooking the valley entering Windshear Crag in the ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:1070:details:1: You seem to be full of wanderlust by the looks of you. Have you been to the ⟦E12⟧? It is a land plagued by the Venture Co. and other enemies of the night elves.
rows.quest:1070:details:2: Recently, Sentinel Wolfrunner sent my friend ⟦E36⟧ there to investigate what's happening to the land, but I have yet to hear word back from her. I'm even more concerned because the ⟦E37⟧ sent a gnome mage along with her... a sign of trouble for sure.
rows.quest:1070:details:3: Would you find her and report back to me?
rows.quest:1070:completion:0: Ah, you've come from ⟦E6⟧ at the behest of Thenysil -- how I miss her, my homeland and friends. She must be doing well with the Sentinels to be sequestering adventurers for other tasks. I'm proud of her.
rows.quest:1070:completion:1: It is a pleasure to meet you, ⟦43⟧.
rows.quest:1085:details:0: The situation here in Stonetalon is obviously grave for a night elf and gnome to be working together.
rows.quest:1085:details:1: ⟦E39⟧ has devastated these lands and I've spent most of my time putting an end to the destruction.
rows.quest:1085:details:2: Do not judge Gaxim prematurely; he understands the need for us to work together.
rows.quest:1085:details:3: If you wish to aid us, then start by speaking to Gaxim.
rows.quest:1085:details:4: I'm sorry I cannot send you back to Tara with good news yet. Perhaps soon.
rows.quest:1085:completion:0: Treacherous...treacherous and dangerous, that's what this land is.
rows.quest:1085:completion:1: But I'm here to show the night elves that it's a little safer with the help of good ole engineering and a dash of magic.
rows.quest:1085:completion:2: See, swearing off magic completely won't help the night elves -- they need it. The world needs it. And with engineering and alchemy to boot, you can't go wrong. The possibilities are endless.
rows.quest:1134:obj:0: Bring 12 Pridewing Venom Sacs to ⟦E16⟧ in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1134:details:0: We are not in open war with the ⟦E32⟧, but our peace is fragile. We often find their agents moving against us, but they do so covertly.
rows.quest:1134:details:1: One such advance was revealed to us from hidden sources in ⟦E40⟧, claiming that the orcs collect venom from the pridewings near Mirkfallon Lake, in the ⟦E12⟧ to the south. Orc assassins then use the venom on their secret death raids against the ⟦E37⟧!
rows.quest:1134:details:2: If this is true, then we must stop them, ⟦44⟧. We must deny them their source of venom.
rows.quest:1134:progress:0: Do you have the pridewing venom sacs, ⟦45⟧? We cannot allow the orcs to use the beasts' poisons against us!
rows.quest:1134:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦46⟧. It saddens me to order the slaughter of creatures who may not willingly aid our enemies, yet it is my duty to do so.
rows.quest:1134:completion:1: Your heart might weep for the pridewings you slew, my friend, but may your heart then swell in knowing that your allies are safe from the pridewings' venom.
rows.quest:1033:details:0: I had hoped Orendil's cure would save Relara, but I fear it only slowed the disease running through my child. We must find more powerful medicine! Thankfully, Orendil spoke to me of further remedies to try should his first one fail.
rows.quest:1033:details:1: ⟦E43⟧ is a type of stone that rests in only one place: the isle on Iris Lake, east of Astranaar. Orendil said the stone will wash away corruption... please, ⟦47⟧, bring me ⟦E43⟧ and pray it will end my child's sickness!
rows.quest:1033:progress:0: ⟦48⟧, did you find Iris Lake? Do you have the Tear?
rows.quest:1033:completion:0: Oh, you found it! I will place the tear in a stew, and pray that it will cure her.
rows.quest:6581:title: ⟦E45⟧
rows.quest:6581:progress:0: Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.⟦50⟧⟦51⟧..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!⟦52⟧⟦53⟧What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.⟦54⟧⟦55⟧So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
rows.quest:6581:completion:0: This is perfect -- just the thing! Well, here's the shipment.
rows.quest:98251:title: Never Coming Back
rows.quest:98251:obj:0: Kill 6 ⟦E47⟧ and 6 ⟦E6⟧ Bear and return to ⟦E48⟧ northwest of ⟦E49⟧.
rows.quest:98252:title: A Void Path
rows.quest:98252:obj:0: Show Va'xug's ⟦E50⟧ the way back to the main ⟦E6⟧ road.
rows.quest:1034:obj:0: Bring 5 Handfuls of Stardust to Pelturas in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1034:details:0: ⟦E43⟧ washed clear some of my daughter's sickness. Her nightmares are lessened and I thank the goddess for her blessing. But ... fever still rages within her.
rows.quest:1034:details:1: Orendil told me of a frosted dust found among the Ruins of Stardust. Perhaps it will abate Relara's fever. Gather some of the dust, then please return to me.
rows.quest:1034:details:2: ⟦E52⟧ lie to the south, ⟦56⟧. May ⟦E53⟧ speed your journey.
rows.quest:1034:progress:0: Do you yet have the Stardust, ⟦57⟧?
rows.quest:1034:completion:0: You gathered the dust! I will create a poultice from these -- it should bring down Relara's fever.
rows.quest:1034:completion:1: Thank you again, ⟦58⟧. Without your help, my child would surely perish.
rows.quest:6641:obj:0: Keep ⟦E54⟧ safe as he travels to the brazier. Help him by putting the brazier out, then protect him as you fight against the Naga.
rows.quest:6641:obj:1: If you are successful, return to the Zoram'gar Outpost and inform the ⟦E55⟧ of the death of ⟦E56⟧.
rows.quest:6641:details:0: ⟦E56⟧... the fiendish hydra that roams the seas...
rows.quest:6641:details:1: She has attacked our outpost, each time unprovoked, laying waste to anything that falls in her path.
rows.quest:6641:details:2: But I am ready, ⟦59⟧. I have prepared to best the hydra and end these attacks on Zoram'gar.
rows.quest:6641:details:3: The naga honor the wicked nature of this beast with a brazier that remains lit on an island just off the coast. I believe that if we put it out, Vorsha will appear in anger.
rows.quest:6641:details:4: We will need help, so be sure to bring some strong allies.
rows.quest:6641:completion:0: I have witnessed many naga attacks since I arrived here. It puts my mind at ease that Vorsha will no longer roam freely.
rows.quest:23:details:0: The paw of the mighty bear Ursangous is your trophy for this part of the ⟦E6⟧ Hunt. On the paw is a small quarter-crescent emblem; the significance of the emblem remains a mystery.
rows.quest:23:details:1: The paw should be brought to ⟦E58⟧ in Splintertree Post to prove that you have bested the mighty creature and completed this portion of the hunt.
rows.quest:23:progress:0: Ah - ⟦61⟧ - I was just thinking about you! How goes your hunting?
rows.quest:23:completion:0: Ah, the paw of Ursangous! Your skill is impressive, ⟦62⟧; he is credited with numerous kills. The crescent on his paw is no doubt a sign that he was trained by the night elves that skulk about ⟦E6⟧. Ursangous is... was one of the mightiest bears you'd find in these parts. To have bested such a creature is a testament to your will and resolve.
rows.quest:216:obj:0: Take down 8 Thistlefur Avengers and 8 ⟦E60⟧; most are located east of Zoram Strand in Thistlefur Village. Once completed, return to ⟦E61⟧ at Zoram'gar Outpost, ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:216:details:0: The Thistlefur furbolgs are threatening our expansion! Thistlefur Village to our east blocks the way between us here and the Splintertree Post. It's a path that would circumvent the village of Astranaar; without it, we give the ⟦E37⟧ an extra expansion path.
rows.quest:216:details:1: B⟦63⟧, we must not allow... an expansion path gap!
rows.quest:216:details:2: Proceed to Thistlefur Village and thin out the furbolgs. You will be given compensation for this task, but more importantly you will be doing your duty for the ⟦E32⟧!
rows.quest:216:progress:0: Have you taken the fight to the Thistlefur?  With a clear path between our bases, our chances of claiming the whole of ⟦E6⟧ increase dramatically.
rows.quest:216:completion:0: Well done ⟦64⟧, well done! I will continue to send forces to thin out the furbolg, but I can at least count on a different path that will be free of ⟦E37⟧ entanglements. The ⟦E32⟧ conquest of ⟦E6⟧ is now in full swing!
rows.quest:216:completion:1: You've earned your pay this day, hero. I salute you!
rows.quest:976:obj:0: Speak with ⟦E62⟧ at Maestra's Post after seeing Feero safely through ⟦E6⟧ Forest.
rows.quest:976:details:0: Delgren has asked me to deliver messages and supplies to Sentinel Starbreeze in Auberdine, but I am loathe to leave on my own. Dangerous foes operate in the forest, and I do not wish to risk letting these supplies and information fall into the wrong hands.
rows.quest:976:details:1: If you and others could act as my guards, I could leave now. With your protection, I have no doubt that we can see these goods safely to Auberdine.
rows.quest:976:progress:0: The Sentinels have a great need for supplies to reinforce themselves in ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:976:completion:0: You have done well today, ⟦65⟧. The items we sent to aid Auberdine will be of immediate use in dealing with the dark threats that infest the forest.
rows.quest:976:completion:1: Take these with my heartfelt thanks.
rows.quest:1016:obj:0: Collect 5 Intact ⟦E63⟧ and use the ⟦E64⟧ on them. Afterwards, bring the ⟦E65⟧ to ⟦E66⟧ at the Silverwind Refuge.
rows.quest:1016:details:0: Take this divining scroll--it can determine the creator of these elementals. But you will need something from them to use as a reagent to focus scroll's magic--their bracers should do nicely.
rows.quest:1016:details:1: BA few intact bracers from the creatures should be enough. The other bracers will be useless for our purposes, but they may be worth something to a merchant if you wish to sell them. Once you have the intact bracers attempt to use the scroll. Return to me with the results and we shall proceed from there.
rows.quest:1016:progress:0: Since you must destroy the bracers to kill the elementals, it will probably be difficult to find the specific ones that contain the information the divining scroll needs. You can trade bracers with others in order to obtain the ones you need, or perhaps you have the divined paper already?
rows.quest:1016:completion:0: Well done, ⟦66⟧, this should give us the information we need to have the culprit discovered. How would you feel about taking out the mage who fills our pools with corrupt elementals? The corruption of ⟦E6⟧ and beyond makes my stomach turn on its own--to have a wizard actively attempting to destroy it further sickens me to no end. We shall make him pay.
rows.quest:1025:obj:0: Kill 1 Den Watcher, 2 Ursas, 10 Totemics, and 12 Warriors of the Foulweald tribe, and then return to ⟦E13⟧ in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1025:details:0: Before you travel to the moonwell I have another task that will aid the people of ⟦E6⟧ if you would like to test your skills.
rows.quest:1025:details:1: Along the road heading east before the Falfarren River, furbolgs have been attacking travelers. Their tortured minds feeding upon fear, and their appetites satiated by the blood of innocents.
rows.quest:1025:details:2: Aid the Sentinels in protecting the lands by showing those monsters the same mercy they have shown our kind.
rows.quest:1025:details:3: I believe their camps are south of the road... be careful.
rows.quest:1025:progress:0: The furbolg were not always our enemy, ⟦67⟧. But times change, and it is no longer a time of peace here in these dark woods.
rows.quest:1025:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦68⟧. Thank you.
rows.quest:6462:obj:0: Bring 8 Troll Charms to ⟦E69⟧ at the Zoram'gar Outpost.
rows.quest:6462:details:0: My kinfolk were traveling here with many sacred troll charms, but the Thistlefur furbolgs attacked and killed them before they reached Zoram'gar! Those vile Furbolgs!
rows.quest:6462:details:1: I miss my brothers and sisters who were killed, but we will meet again in the afterlife. However, their troll charms hold great value in this world. It is an outrage that the furbolgs have them!
rows.quest:6462:details:2: B⟦69⟧, you must retrieve the charms! They are in chests in Thistlefur Hold, a cave at the end of Thistlefur Village, north of Astranaar.
rows.quest:6462:progress:0: Did you find the charms, ⟦70⟧?  Every moment the furbolgs possess those sacred items, my blood boils with rage!
rows.quest:6462:completion:0: You found them! Thank you! Thank you, ⟦71⟧! You do not know how great a thing you have done for me.
rows.quest:6462:completion:1: BA troll without his charm is like an orc without his battle scars...
